fields.description: Legal name printed on the billing document.
fields.label: Registered Name

fields.description: Shown beside your name on the booking page and printed on the billing document.
fields.label: Logo

fields.description: URL key used in printed deep links (?c=<slug>). Renaming is Platform-Admin-only and breaks published URLs.
fields.label: Slug

fields.description: 2–6 uppercase letters/digits. Immutable after first save — feeds the BK-/INV- numbering series. Derived from the slug when left blank.
fields.label: Company Code

fields.description: Wide header image across the top of your booking page (/book). A landscape shot of the venue works best — roughly 1600×400.
fields.label: Banner

fields.description: Shown to customers on your booking page (/book), in the same strip as the Photos button, and opened in a new tab. Links only: keep your own pages updated and customers see them there — nothing is copied or synced here. Leave a field empty and no chip is drawn for it.
fields.label: Website & Social Links

fields.description: Full address starting with https:// (or http://), e.g. https://www.ayalacourts.ph
fields.label: Website

fields.description: Your Facebook page, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/ayalacourts — must be on facebook.com, fb.com or fb.me
fields.label: Facebook Page

fields.description: Your Instagram profile, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/ayalacourts — must be on instagram.com or instagr.am
fields.label: Instagram

fields.description: Billing-document amounts are VAT-INCLUSIVE at this rate.
fields.label: VAT (%)

fields.description: Title printed on the billing document (EOPT-aware default).
fields.label: Billing Document Title

fields.description: Bank / GCash details shown to the customer at checkout for Fund Transfer payments.
fields.label: Payment Instructions

fields.description: THIS facility's own policy, set by the platform (you can read it; ask us to change it). Refund: a paid booking may be cancelled and the money returned. Reschedule only: the desk moves it to another time, or issues store credit — a facility-fault cancellation may still return cash. Printed for the customer at checkout and on their booking.
fields.label: Refund Policy

fields.description: Who may record a cancellation as THIS facility's own fault — which returns cash whatever the Refund Policy above says. Set per facility by the platform (you can read it; ask us to change it), and it applies under both refund policies.
fields.label: Facility-Fault Cancellation By
fields.options:
Company Admin only
Staff and above

fields.description: How far ahead this company's customers may reserve online.
fields.label: Booking Window

fields.description: Customers may book today + this many days, inclusive (the portal date strip stops there too). 0 = platform default. Staff booking at the desk is never limited by this.
fields.label: Advance Booking (Days)

fields.description: How many separate bookings one customer may put in a single cart checkout. 0 = platform default. The platform's own figure is a CEILING — asking for more than it gives you the platform's number, not yours.
fields.label: Max Bookings per Cart

fields.description: Free a paid slot nobody turned up for, so the desk can resell it.
fields.label: No-show Release

fields.description: 0 = no automatic release (the default — nothing changes for you). Set a number of minutes and a Confirmed booking nobody has checked in for is released back to the board that many minutes after it was due to start, free for a walk-in. The payment is NOT refunded: the statement stays Paid & Verified, and a release made in error can be undone from the board.
fields.label: No-show Release (Minutes)

fields.description: Verification-clock configuration — when finance verifies fund transfers.
fields.label: Payment Verification

fields.description: When finance actually verifies transfers (company-level: one finance function, one bank account). Drives the proof verification deadline.
fields.label: Office Hours

fields.description: Minutes before an unpaid reservation expires. 0 = platform default.
fields.label: Reservation Expiry (Minutes)

fields.description: Cumulative OFFICE-HOURS time staff get to review a payment proof. 0 = platform default.
fields.label: Verification Hold (Office Hours)

fields.description: Platform-Admin-only levers.
fields.label: Platform

fields.description: When on, this company's admins manage their own branches. Off = Platform Admin adds branches.
fields.label: Allow Self Branch Management

fields.description: When on, this company's admins add, reorder and remove the photos on the company and on its branches. Off = the platform manages them. Staff can always look at photos; they never edit.
fields.label: Allow Company Admin to Modify Gallery Content

fields.description: Subscription and Percentage are absorbed by the company — the customer never sees them. Per Booking is an ADD-ON the customer pays on top of the court, printed as its own "Booking fee" line, which the company collects and remits on its monthly statement.
fields.label: Billing Mode

fields.description: Marginal brackets on a MONTHLY count of paid bookings (an extension counts as its own booking; a reschedule keeps its fee). Contiguous from 1; leave the last tier's To blank. The fee is fixed when the booking is made and printed on the customer's statement.
fields.label: Booking Fee Tiers

fields.description: Charged to EACH paying open play participant on top of the session fee. Open play sessions never enter the booking count above. 0 = no open play fee.
fields.label: Open Play Fee (per participant)

fields.description: Live go-live status, derived from the data — nothing here is a checkbox someone ticked.
fields.label: Go-live Checklist

fields.description: This company's branches — read and edit them here without leaving the company. Each branch's own form still exists; Open takes you there.
fields.label: Branches
